name: Mini Golf
subtitle: Top-down, one putt at a time
description: A small green seen from directly above, a flag somewhere across it, and one ball each. Drag back from anywhere and let go — the further you pull, the harder it goes. Every hole is built fresh: a rectangle or a half-round, with bunkers to bog you down, ponds to avoid and blocks to bank off. Fewest strokes takes it. Play a quick round against the bot, share a device, or take three friends online.
controls: Drag back from anywhere with a mouse or a finger and let go to putt. Arrows aim, Space putts.
